title: Retry production deployment with domain awake01

requirements.text: Retry production deployment using the domain name "awake01" (and only that domain change) so the deployment meets the platform domain naming rules (5–50 characters; letters, numbers, and hyphens only) and completes successfully.

quotes: Yes Lets try prod deployment jus change de domain name to awake01

acceptanceCriteria: Production deployment is triggered with the domain set to "awake01".
The domain "awake01" is accepted by the deployment validator (length and character rules).
Deployment completes successfully and the app is reachable at the resulting production URL for domain "awake01".

constraints: Do not change application features or UI behavior; only adjust the production deployment domain to "awake01" and re-deploy.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding new keep-awake features, settings, or UI indicators.
Backend changes (the backend actor can remain empty).
